translation: When a bone has left its position, one must lift it with the manual technique; then, without waiting for a long time, the bone seam (骨縫) will join. Still, it must be neither biased nor leaning, so that after recovery there is no affliction of unequal length. <ins>Raising method (提法)</ins> Raising means drawing out the sunken bone to its former state. Its methods are not one: some use both hands to raise, some use a rope or cloth tied to a high place to raise, and some, after raising, use an instrument to assist so that it does not sink again. One must measure the severity and depth of the injury, and then apply treatment.
